answer_1.quote: We aim to compare the difference in consistency of zero-shot prompted LLM-generated dialogue summaries with smaller fine-tuned model-generated summaries.

answer_2.quote: We systematically evaluate the performance of state-of-the-art error detectors on LLM-generated dialogue summaries.

answer_3.quote: We introduce two prompt-based methods for fine-grained error detection, which notably outperform all prior state-of-the-art error detectors, particularly in identifying the newly introduced error type, "Circumstantial Inference."

answer_4.quote: We enlist two linguist factcheckers from Upwork to assess summary consistency.
answer_4.guideline: Annotators were directed to spot inconsistencies in summaries, marked by spans that lack evidence in the source text or distort information from it.
